name: Hot Wife Tara
source:
After many years of being faithful to one another in marriage, Harry's wife Tara decided for her birthday to undertake the darkest and yet most fantasized scenario every married man envisions; a threesome. For months, she talked about and planned and even had a candidate, her friend Ruby. She does not know that the two are married, and that's how she wants him to act; he walks in, pretends not to know Tara, and attempts to win her and her friend over with his charm and sexual bravado. But even the most well-made plans can have snags, for if Harry fails, there are plenty of others in the bar that night who may be up to the task.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880860/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
结婚多年、始终忠贞的哈利，妻子塔拉决定在生日时尝试每个已婚男人都曾幻想过的最黑暗情景：三人行。数月以来，她不断讨论、筹划，甚至选好了人选——朋友露比。她不知道两人已婚，却正希望他如此表现：他走进酒吧，假装不认识塔拉，试图靠魅力与性自信赢得她和朋友的芳心。然而，即使计划再周密也可能出岔子；如果哈利失败，当晚酒吧里还有许多人愿意接手。
